principle: Preserve original category/classification, status, run and evidence. Normalization is separate metadata and never confirms a finding.
teacher_mapping: Preserve the v3 classification and suspected status. Never map suspected defect to confirmed. observation_kind may remain unspecified until review.

review_recommendations.rationale: Unimplemented configuration is not by itself proof of violating the supported contract.
Unimplemented configuration is not by itself proof of violating the supported contract.

definitions.high: Supported use can materially corrupt numerical results or data, or broadly prevent operation.
definitions.medium: A bounded feature or configuration can fail, stall, or materially misbehave.
definitions.low: Documentation, help, or localized usability issue without demonstrated computational impact.
definitions.unknown: Reachability, affected contract or impact has not been assessed.

impact.rule: Impact is independent of confidence and confirmation. Never infer a level solely from category. Preserve unknown rather than fabricate reachability.
impact.examples: A JSONL help-text typo can be a low usability defect; a cost-buffer issue concerns numerical correctness, but its scope and impact still require assessment.

limitations: This policy does not implement the retrospective ledger or sample filtering.
Existing reviewed v2/v3 artifacts and extraction inventories are not migrated or edited.
